resources.string:
Copies of Sofa from GitHub don't get updates from an app store. Sofa can look for a new version on its GitHub page when it starts, at most once a day, and offer to install it.

This connects to github.com, which sees your IP address. Updates come straight from the developer's GitHub releases, without the review that an app store such as F-Droid adds, and Android asks you to confirm each one.

You can change this any time in Settings, which also has a button to check by hand.
Check for updates when Sofa starts
At most once a day. Connects to github.com; nothing installs without your confirmation.
If you turn on update checks, Sofa also connects to github.com.
